focus: Behind the scenes this week: we made the site load faster on the homepage (the featured game cover now preloads the moment your browser reads the HTML, not after layout), added seven dedicated leaderboard category pages for better search discoverability, and added automated Lighthouse performance regression detection so any future slowdowns are caught before shipping.
